label: v5_r4_move_s0_ep390_r2_a1random_a2rl_es0_r4ve
config_content:
# P2-a (research_plan Sec.P2-a, promoted to P1): identical to r4_move_exp3parity.yml
# EXCEPT pretrain = v5_base_l1 ep200 (Encoder retrained under probe-Q) instead of r3_stay_400.
# Isolates the Encoder factor from the Q-range factor (P1.75).
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQValueEstimation
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: MotionGenerationPredictionFeaturePredictionRunner  # P0-4: exp3-parity (see r4_ve_exp3parity.yml). Renamed alias GeneratorTrainingFeaturePredictionRunner planned.
data:
    name: r2_a1random_a2rl
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: v5_base_l1
        seed: 0
        epoch: 200
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 400
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - vision_encoder_module
            - vision_decoder_module
            - integration_module
            - feature_prediction_module
            - share_lns
            - probe_critic
            - superposition_module
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
